name: Erik Marquardt - Après le § 10 - Am 3
title: SECOND REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Union agencies for the financial year 2023
part_text: 10 a. Regrets that the Management Board’s refusal to follow the disciplinary recommendations of OLAF, despite documented findings in recruitment and management practices, sends a message of impunity; underlines that no Union body can demand citizens’ trust while tolerating misconduct within its ranks; calls on the Commission to assess whether the Agency’s current governance model still ensures accountability and transparency;
